sources.title: Embassy of Panama: immigration and visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Panamanian Government embassy immigration page publishes a named no-visa visitor-country list and includes Argentina, separately from conditional third-country visa or residence routes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: No Visa RequireD: IF you are from any of the following countries ... Argentina

sources.title: Trinidad and Tobago visa requirements for all countries
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and CARICOM Affairs of Trinidad and Tobago
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Ministry schedule records the 2000 Argentina agreement separately from diplomatic/official passport terms and expressly specifies the ordinary vacation or business visitor exemption.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa not required for entry on Vacation or Business for up to 90 days

policies.title: Argentine ordinary passports: Panama short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Panama's current embassy immigration guidance names Argentina in its no-visa visitor-country list for stays of up to three months.
conditions: Ordinary Argentine passport holder, visitor stay of up to three months; carry the stated passport validity, return/onward travel and funds where requested.
Employment, residence, transit, conditional third-country visa or residence routes, special passports and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Argentine ordinary passports: Trinidad and Tobago vacation or business visa exemption
policies.summary: Trinidad and Tobago's official nationality schedule records the Argentina agreement as no visa required for vacation or business visits up to 90 days.
conditions: Ordinary Argentine passport holder travelling for vacation or business, up to 90 days.
Employment, residence, transit, diplomatic and official-passport arrangements, and final admission remain separate.
